title: Associated primes and v-numbers of integral closures of powers of edge ideals
summary: Let $I = I(G)$ be the edge ideal of a finite simple graph $G$. We investigate the relationship between the associated primes and $v$-numbers of powers $I^t$ and their integral closures $\overline{I^t}$. For the third power, we establish the associated prime containment $\operatorname{Ass}(S/\overline{I^3}) \subseteq \operatorname{Ass}(S/I^3)$, which yields $v(I^3) \le v(\overline{I^3})$. In contrast, for $t \ge 4$, we show that $\operatorname{Ass}(S/\overline{I^t})$ and $\operatorname{Ass}(S/I^t)$ are in general incomparable.
